portfolio.descricao: I maintain open-source libraries I developed on GitHub, published on nuget.org and npmjs.org, as well as technical challenges completed during selection processes. Here are the links:
portfolio.ResultPattern: .NET library for error handling using the Result Pattern, returning success or failure explicitly, with statuses mapped automatically, without relying on exceptions for flow control. A pattern I also implemented professionally in projects at Smart Travel and Olik
portfolio.FluentBlueprintBuilder: .NET library for fluent object creation based on scenarios and predefined values, especially useful for assembling data for automated tests. Also used in projects at Smart Travel and Olik
portfolio.ngxShowFormErrors: Angular library that automates the display of form validation error messages
portfolio.CashFlow: Simulation of cash flow entries and reports in .NET, with unit tests (xUnit), behavioral tests (BDD), and load tests (K6), containerized with Docker, using PostgreSQL as the database and Seq for logs
portfolio.BestRoute: .NET API that, given N routes, calculates the cheapest path between two points (nodes). A classic graph problem solved with Dijkstra’s algorithm and covered by unit tests in xUnit
portfolio.Test-C: Simple .NET API for product search, with simulated business rules and an in-memory database

empresas.descricao: Tech Lead and full-stack developer (.NET, Angular, and Vue/Nuxt)
atividades: I joined as a .NET developer and was promoted to Tech Lead 6 months later, in April 2026. I first led a squad of 4 developers and 1 QA in building a mobile application for the aesthetics sector, using .NET, Flutter, and Angular. I then led a squad of the same size in creating from scratch a product specialized in the insurance sector for the insurer Fairfax, using .NET and Vue/Nuxt. In this project, I designed and developed the base architecture as a Modular Monolith with BFF, and guided the team toward the solution throughout the sprints. I also taught the team to work with Scrum and agility, established the Scrum ceremonies and workflows in Jira, and helped the Product Owner review and structure the stories in the Product Backlog from the beginning of the project, participating in meetings with the client and understanding the product rules and goals broadly.

In addition to the work in the squads, I created and led the "Papo de Código" (Code Talk) initiative, where we held biweekly chats with developers from across the company, and professionals from related areas such as POs and managers also participated. In these meetings, I raised topics of interest to the participants and facilitated the discussions so that the conversation flowed smoothly.

empresas.descricao: Tech Lead and full-stack developer (.NET and Angular)
atividades: Acted as tech lead of a team of 7 developers, assisting in the development of activities, understanding of the architecture, maintenance of best practices and company conventions, Code Review (Pull Request analysis), conduction of ceremonies, and promoting improvements in the development flow and processes. I also managed the team’s impediments, resolving them directly with other areas of the company or with external companies.

Development on a key product to enable greater automation in credit analyses, focused especially on integrations with various external systems, using REST, SOAP, and even RPA (automation) with Selenium, and making them available for internal consumption through proprietary APIs. I also implemented queuing with Hangfire and assisted in configuring Amazon Cognito for OIDC. Main tools: .NET, SQL Server, Azure DevOps, and AWS. Internal portal developed in Angular.
Development of the new intranet system for CICC-SP, developing new features and maintaining existing ones. Architecture based on Clean Architecture and CQRS, using ASP.NET, SQL Server, and Angular.

empresas.descricao: Full-stack developer (.NET and Angular) and Software Architect
atividades: Development of new features, maintenance, and bug fixing in SmartBus, a bus ticket sales and management system, using ASP.NET (framework 4.6, .NET 7, and .NET 8), SQL Server, Angular, React, and RabbitMQ, in a three-tier architecture system (BLL, DAL, UI).

As an architect, I was responsible for the creation of two projects from scratch, both in architecture design and coding, focused on asynchronous processing of high-volume batch data. These projects were created to serve as the standard model for the company’s new projects. In them, I introduced new patterns and technologies, such as integration with queues via RabbitMQ, logs in ElasticSearch with Serilog, Result Pattern for error handling, Clean Architecture in both, and CQRS in one of them, for example. The new systems also brought a significant improvement in the implementation of multitenancy, with a solution redesigned from scratch, making the database connection dynamic according to the client identified in the request.

Worked on the project to rewrite the Official Gazette of the State of São Paulo from scratch, using ASP.NET (.NET 6), React, SQL Server, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, and Node.js, among other technologies. I participated in the creation of some .NET projects and, notably, was responsible for the creation from scratch of a Node.js project with Clean Architecture and processing via RabbitMQ queues.

Development of new features, maintenance, and bug fixing in Radar, the company’s main system, which offers various management tools for associated entrepreneurs, from registration of associates and products and management of marketing campaigns to a small integrated e-commerce. We mainly used ASP.NET Core in the APIs, Angular in the front-ends, and MySQL in the database, among other technologies. We used Sentry as a service for error tracking and monitoring. The cloud service used was AWS. I helped implement queues using RabbitMQ and was responsible for the full-stack development of several complete epics, end-to-end.

Worked in the squad responsible for the Corporate Charges microservice, with maintenance, analysis, and bug fixing, and implementation of new features in .NET Core APIs with CQRS, SQL Server, and integration with other systems. I helped implement process queuing with RabbitMQ. I had a strong role in PDF payment slip (boleto) generation and in the complete rewriting of the CNAB file generation module to support high-volume batch data processing.

I was the team’s Security Champion, a role of integration with the Information Security squad, of which I was also a part, transmitting pentest results to the team, promoting security best practices, and the correction of possible vulnerabilities.

I was one of those responsible for the complete rewrite of a legacy internal system, migrating from MPA (traditional ASP.NET MVC) to SPA with Angular and .NET Core. The system controlled and managed scripts and routines requested by users without execution privileges, for later analysis and execution by the responsible area. The front-end was redesigned with a more modern and usable interface, and the back-end was refactored to serve the new front-end and migrated to .NET Core. I also implemented integration tests with Selenium.
The hiring was under a temporary contract, with hours specifically allocated for the project in question.

I was the technical lead for the creation from scratch of the front-end of the new National Customer Registry, an important internal system that was being completely rewritten and that allowed various types of queries across the bank’s entire customer base. I defined and developed the front-end architecture from scratch, both the code structure and the layout, and developed most of the application until my departure. In this project, I worked exclusively as front-end.

empresas.descricao: Full-stack developer (.NET, .NET Core, AngularJS, Angular, and Node.js)
atividades: Development of new features and bug fixes in the company’s systems. The main system was a personal loan offer comparison platform, developed in .NET, Angular, and AngularJS, with a migration in progress to .NET Core. Other internal projects also used other technologies, such as NodeJS and Python. I also created queries for MongoDB and managed the execution in production of some RPAs built with Selenium.

empresas.descricao: Full-stack developer (.NET, .NET Core, AngularJS, and Angular)
atividades: Consulting and system development in a software factory, using ASP.NET (Framework and Core), C#, SQL Server, AngularJS, and Angular. As a full-stack developer, I participated in the development of several products from start to finish, also contributing to entity and table modeling. Among the projects, I highlight the post-sale control system for SalfaCorp, one of the largest engineering companies in Chile; an online course platform; and a complete evaluation system, with exam registration with various question types, application to the student, automatic correction of objective questions, and correction by the teacher of discursive ones.
On-site allocation in Santiago, Chile.

Initially, I worked on Gepro, the company’s main proprietary product, focused on claims and their provisions, which generated reports and pointed out possible inconsistencies in the databases of major insurers in the country. In this system, developed in ASP.NET Web Forms, Crystal Reports, and SQL Server, I gained significant experience in creating and maintaining procedures, which were the data source for various reports.

Later, I worked on the Portal do Corretor, an important system of Brasil Brokers used by brokers and internal administration, where properties, clients, potential clients with their interests, and sales were registered. It was the project to which I dedicated the most time in the company. Occasionally, I also supported the team responsible for the Brasil Brokers portal.
I also assisted in the initial development of Girus, a new system of the company similar to Gepro, focused on the reinsurance market.

My activities included requirements gathering with the client, analysis and resolution of errors, development of new modules and features, and writing documentation. Main technologies: ASP.NET, C#, and SQL Server.

Analysis and resolution of errors; support in the development of new systems; writing documentation and manual execution of tests. Main technologies used: ASP.NET, C#, and SQL Server. The main client I worked for was Cultura Inglesa, where I participated in the development of a distance learning portal (online course) and maintenance of a system in classic ASP.

textoExtra: In addition to the experiences listed above, previously I completed two other internships as a developer, worked twice in technical support, worked as a computer maintenance technician at Caixa Econômica Federal (brazilian public bank), and my first job was as a telemarketing attendant for Tim, at the age of 18.
